literal_meaning: খিচুড়ি রান্না করা বা মিশিয়ে জট পাকানো
figurative_meaning_en: To make something complicated or disorganized
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই বিতর্ক সবকিছু খিচুড়ি পাকিয়ে তুলেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He has turned the project into a complete mess.
This debate has muddled everything up.
note: The idiom draws from the preparation of khichuri, a simple mixed dish in Bengali cuisine, symbolizing a jumble or tangle.
